meta.title: FCC Ultimate Performance + Stability Loop
meta.goal: Highest stable performance; prefer Rust for hot paths; never lose correctness or security
meta.vi: Tối ưu đỉnh cao, ổn định; ưu tiên Rust cho hot-path; không đánh đổi correctness/security

problem.statement_en: FCC is a multi-provider coding-agent proxy (~60k LOC Python). Latency is dominated by: request validation, path normalization, rate-limit checks, token estimation on stream chunks, JSON-ish sanitization, metrics recording, and admin UI paint. User wants continuous plan/build/pentest/debug loops aiming at Rust-backed ultra cores while keeping a pure-Python fallback so the product never breaks when rustc/maturin is unavailable.
problem.statement_vi: FCC là proxy multi-provider. Nút thắt: validation, normalize path, rate-limit, ước lượng token khi stream, sanitize, metrics, UI. Cần loop plan/build/pentest và core Rust + fallback Python để luôn chạy được.

FlowerSkill.user_prompt_restated_en: Continue optimizing and coding to the highest quality. Self-drive the full loop: plan → stats → build → pentest → debug → loop. Prioritize stability and best possible code. Target Rust for maximum performance. Always read the Flower skill, recreate this prompt as XML + English so the problem is crystal clear, and do this on 100% of chats.

execution_plan.phase: Measure LOC, hot modules, middleware order, security surface, deploy pack.
Persist XML skill + EN restatement in-repo (skills/).
Bloom filter, LRU/TTL cache, path/id validators, sliding window rate limiter, token approx, metrics ring — zero extra deps, always available.
PyO3/maturin-ready crate mirroring Python ultra APIs (bloom, validate, hash, rate limit, token approx). Build when toolchain exists; otherwise document.
Plug ultra core into api/security, api/rate_limit, api/metrics, detection, token_estimation, admin asset allowlist.
content-visibility, contain, will-change sparingly, reduce layout thrash on metrics/provider grids.
Extend security tests; micro-benchmarks for bloom/validate/rate-limit; update PENTEST + PHASE4 docs.
Commit + push branch; open/update PR; never invent non-existent history.
Dedicated admin API token, auth SlidingWindow, security event ring + live tail, JSON compact helpers on Responses tools, Helm chart.
CI native wheels, stream SSE JSON ultra, latency histogram + provider bars, CI-safe annotations (no future/type-ignore in Phase modules).
Record provider_latency on live proxy turns; optional WebSocket log stream; PWA; deeper multi-node metrics.

success_metrics.m: Python ultra validators < 1µs typical small inputs (bench)
Negative membership checks O(k) bit ops; no false negatives
Import path works with or without native module
No secret leakage; path traversal still blocked

anti_patterns.a: Do not claim Raven Office commits that are not on git
Do not require Rust at runtime
Do not use innerHTML with user data
Do not weaken rate limits or auth to chase benchmarks

every_chat_ritual.step: 2. Restate user intent as XML + English
